title: EURES Job Scraper
description: Scrape job vacancies from EURES using fast API capture from the search listing pages.

startUrl.title: Start URL
startUrl.description: Specific EURES search URL. If omitted, a default URL is used.

keyword.title: Keyword
keyword.description: Optional keyword searched across EURES vacancy fields. Overrides keywords from startUrl when provided.

location.title: Location code
location.description: Optional EURES location or NUTS code, such as fi1b. Use comma-separated codes for multiple locations.

country.title: Country code
country.description: Optional ISO country code used by EURES, such as fi or de. Use comma-separated codes for multiple countries.

sort.title: Sort order
sort.description: Choose how EURES orders matching vacancies.

results_wanted.title: Results Wanted
results_wanted.description: Maximum number of vacancies to save.

max_pages.title: Max Pages
max_pages.description: Maximum number of listing pages to process.
